sources.title: WebVTT: The Web Video Text Tracks Format
sources.version_commit: W3C Candidate Recommendation Draft, 2026-05-20; draft status expressly says work in progress
sources.locator: Status L2-L46; single-kind file §3.1; cue timing §4.5 L888-L894; Unicode §2.2 L559-L562; voice/settings/features §1.4 and cue data model
sources.observed_operation: Opened exact W3C snapshot and inspected status, timing, overlap, normalization, single-kind and feature passages.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Cues must be ordered by nondecreasing start, have end after start, and may overlap; no Unicode normalization; a file contains only one data kind. Styling/rendering capabilities are limited by conforming user agent.
sources.applicability: Supports the draft's cue/timeline and language-preservation analysis, while requiring an exact profile/player for any support promise.

sources.title: Timed Text Markup Language 2 (TTML2)
sources.locator: §§5.2 Profiles; 7.2 frameRate/frameRateMultiplier/tickRate/timeBase; §12 time expressions; Appendix I time-to-media semantics
sources.observed_operation: Opened exact Recommendation and inspected profile/time parameter definitions and time-expression semantics.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Frame and tick time expressions depend on document time-base and frame/tick parameters; defaults may apply if values are omitted.
sources.applicability: Confirms that profile and source timing parameters matter to faithful conversion; does not determine which profile users require.

sources.title: EPUB 3.3
sources.locator: §4.1 OCF abstract/physical container; §4.3.2 ZIP requirements; §9 Media Overlays
sources.observed_operation: Opened the exact W3C Recommendation and inspected ZIP/OCF constraints and media overlay structure.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: OCF uses a constrained ZIP container with manifest/package requirements; media overlays synchronize structured text and audio. This is EPUB-specific and book-oriented.
sources.applicability: Supports EPUB as a package/synchronization precedent, not a drop-in lesson-package schema.

sources.title: Matroska Element Specification
sources.version_commit: Official living specification; page does not expose a dated release snapshot
sources.observed_operation: Opened official element table and located FlagDefault definition.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: FlagDefault indicates eligibility for automatic selection by a player; player selection details are further specified in notes.
sources.applicability: Supports preserving track flags without treating them as the component's definitive track-selection policy.

sources.title: Matroska Specification Notes
sources.version_commit: Official living specification notes; no dated release snapshot shown
sources.observed_operation: Opened official notes and inspected default flag semantics.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Default is a SHOULD-level player hint; eligibility can also depend on language and selection behavior.

sources.title: ELAN Media Files and Annotation Files
sources.version_commit: Current official manual page; no version identifier displayed
sources.locator: Media/annotation file section, statement that tier setup, time alignment, and annotations are saved in annotation file
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official manual and inspected the statement separating annotations from linked media.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Annotation and tier semantics reside in the EAF/imported annotation file; media are linked separately.
sources.applicability: Supports treating EAF as a linked annotation model, not a self-contained media package.

sources.title: ELAN Tier model
sources.version_commit: Current official ELAN manual page; no version identifier displayed
sources.observed_operation: Used official manual search/open results for tier definitions, parent relations, and time-alignment constraints.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Independent tiers are time-alignable and the None stereotype disallows overlap; dependent tiers inherit or constrain alignment through parent relationships; tier type controls subdivision/association.
sources.applicability: Shows why a flat cue model must preserve or diagnose EAF tier relationships and why overlap behavior depends on tier type.

sources.title: Praat TextGrid
sources.version_commit: Current official Praat manual page; no version identifier displayed
sources.locator: Description, interval tier and point tier definitions
sources.observed_operation: Opened official manual and inspected object/tier description.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: A TextGrid has interval tiers made of labeled intervals and point tiers made of labeled points.
sources.applicability: Supports its use as a focused alignment annotation alternative, not a package model.

sources.title: zipfile — Work with ZIP archives
sources.locator: ZipFile.open § duplicate names; extract/extractall warnings; zipfile.Path sanitation note
sources.observed_operation: Opened exact versioned docs and inspected ZipInfo member addressing and extraction/path warnings.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Duplicate names can be addressed using ZipInfo; extract APIs attempt sanitation but warn to inspect untrusted archives; zipfile.Path does not sanitize. The docs do not provide product quotas or certify an application extractor.
sources.applicability: Supports preflight, entry identity and caller-owned path/type/quota policy.

sources.title: The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Data Interchange Format
sources.observed_operation: Opened RFC Editor text and inspected duplicate object-name guidance.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Member names SHOULD be unique; behavior on duplicates is unpredictable across implementations.
sources.applicability: Supports rejecting duplicate manifest keys for interoperable interpretation.

sources.title: UTF-8, a transformation format of ISO 10646
sources.locator: §3 decoding invalid sequences; §4 valid UTF-8 grammar
sources.observed_operation: Opened RFC Editor text and inspected UTF-8 validity and decoding requirements.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Decoders must protect against invalid UTF-8 sequences; valid encodings have constrained octet forms.
sources.applicability: Supports strict decoding and explicit byte diagnostics instead of silent repair.

sources.title: Tags for Identifying Languages
sources.observed_operation: Opened RFC Editor text and inspected language-tag case treatment and preferred presentation.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Language tags and subtags are case-insensitive; capitalization conventions carry no meaning.
sources.applicability: Supports explicit language tags and retaining source/display values separately.

sources.title: FFmpeg WebVTT demuxer source
sources.locator: read_ts; webvtt_read_header; STYLE/REGION/NOTE skip, 1/1000 stream time base, malformed timing breaks loop, cue side data
sources.observed_operation: Opened tagged source and inspected timestamp parsing, timebase, block handling, error path, and packet metadata.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: This release-specific demuxer ignores STYLE/REGION/NOTE blocks, stores identifier/settings as side data, uses millisecond ticks, and breaks its header loop on invalid timestamps.
sources.applicability: Demonstrates why format capability and adapter capability/loss reporting must be distinguished.

sources.title: FFmpeg SubRip muxer source
sources.locator: ff_srt_muxer output-format declaration and packet writer
sources.observed_operation: Opened tagged source; inspected timebase, SRT event writing and MAX_ONE_OF_EACH flag.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The muxer uses one subtitle stream of each type as a maximum and writes SRT event timing/text; this is FFmpeg-specific behavior.
sources.applicability: Supports one explicit sidecar per chosen track when using this adapter, but not broad player compatibility.

sources.title: FFmpeg command-line documentation
sources.version_commit: Current official online docs; unversioned and warns code may change
sources.observed_operation: Opened official CLI docs and inspected automatic selection and explicit mapping rules.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Without -map, one acceptable stream of each type is automatically chosen; manual maps restrict inclusion except filtergraph conditions.
sources.applicability: Supports explicit user selection/mapping for any FFmpeg-backed export adapter; current docs are not release-pinned.
